title: A nurture email never reaches a lead without an account who has not opted in

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system)

detail:
A lead with no profile_id skipped resolveSendGate in the nurture runner and was cancelled only when consent_state was 'unsubscribed' or the address was suppressed. A lead whose consent was 'unknown' (an imported contact, an event RSVP, a scan invite) could therefore receive nurture steps. Every current enrollment path only enrolls confirmed subscribers or members (/subscribe confirm, /start when subscribed, /join with a profile) and production had 0 enrollments on 2026-11-19, so the hole was dormant. Resend's Acceptable Use Policy requires an explicit opt-in, and Space campaigns already require 'subscribed' via canEmailContact.

DONE 2026-11-19: the profile-less branch cancels the enrollment unless consent_state is 'subscribed' (fail closed; a missing or unknown state ends the series). Members keep the lifecycle send gate. Two runner tests: an unknown-consent lead is cancelled without a send, an unknown-consent member still goes through the gate.

verify.note: Passes while the profile-less branch cancels any lead that is not 'subscribed' before the send claim.
